lines.text: Amaziah becomes king at twenty-five, reigns twenty-nine years in Jerusalem, and does right in the LORD's eyes, but not wholeheartedly.
Amaziah executes the servants who murdered his father but spares their sons, following what is written in the Law of Moses.
Amaziah hires 100,000 mighty men from Moab for a hundred talents of silver, and a man of God says not to take them.
Amaziah sends the Ephraimite troops home, then leads Judah to the Valley of the Jordan, where he strikes down 10,000 men of Seir.
Amaziah returns from Edom, sets up the gods of the Seirites and worships them, and the LORD sends a prophet who is told to stop.
